compat.description: Compatibility switches for migrating from other linters.

exclude.description: Root-relative globs excluded from every rule. Directory globs also exclude their contents.

include.description: Root-relative globs of files to lint. Default: all `.ex` and `.exs` files.

rules_dir.description: Directory containing one rule per `<id>.toml` file, relative to this config file.

snapshot_file.description: Committable violation snapshot, relative to this config file.

suppression_dialects.description: External suppression syntax. Only suppresses rules declaring aliases for the dialect.

credo_directives.description:
Honor `# credo:disable-for-this-file`, `-for-next-line`, `-for-previous-line` and
`-for-lines:N` comments for rules that declare `compat.credo`.

SuppressionDialect.description: Data-defined suppression syntax. Each regex must capture a nonempty `targets` group.

advance_consecutive.description: Advance next-line directives over consecutive recognized next-line directives.

file.description: Rust regex matching file-wide directives. Capture whitespace-separated targets as `targets`.

next_line.description: Regex matching directives that suppress the following physical line.

normalize_hyphens.description: Normalize hyphens to underscores in both directive targets and rule aliases.

raw_text.description: Explicit legacy mode: scan raw source lines, including strings, instead of comments.
